title: Parameters — LightGBM documentation
why_relevant: Confirms GPU training switches (device_type), speed/accuracy tradeoffs (max_bin, gpu_use_dp) needed for large-scale tabular training on local_gpu/kaggle_gpu.
extracted_technique: Use device_type=gpu/cuda, consider smaller max_bin (e.g., 63) for speed, and optionally gpu_use_dp=true for higher-precision accumulation (slower).
query: LightGBM Parameters device_type gpu max_bin gpu_use_dp
takeaway: LightGBM GPU training is controlled by device_type and benefits from smaller max_bin; GPU uses 32-bit accumulation by default, which can be changed with gpu_use_dp at a speed cost.

title: GPU Support — XGBoost documentation
why_relevant: Provides the primary, reproducible reference for enabling XGBoost GPU training to diversify ensembles and speed training on millions of rows.
extracted_technique: Train with tree_method=gpu_hist (plus GPU predictor defaults) and keep a CPU fallback when GPU is unavailable.
query: XGBoost GPU Support gpu_hist tree_method documentation
takeaway: XGBoost supports GPU-accelerated tree building; gpu_hist is the key switch for fast training and can be paired with standard early-stopping + weighting.

title: Temporal Fusion Transformers for Interpretable Multi-horizon Time Series Forecasting
why_relevant: A strong reference architecture for multi-horizon forecasting; useful if boosted trees plateau and a major model upgrade is needed.
extracted_technique: Multi-horizon sequence model with attention/gating for mixing static and time-varying covariates; can be adapted to windowed supervised learning with strict past-only context.
query: Temporal Fusion Transformer arXiv multi-horizon forecasting interpretable
takeaway: TFT is a practical template for multi-horizon forecasting with interpretability; it motivates a deep-learning branch if tree ensembles stop improving.

title: N-BEATS: Neural basis expansion analysis for interpretable time series forecasting
why_relevant: Defines a competitive deep time-series baseline family (residual MLP stacks) that can be implemented without exotic dependencies if a neural approach becomes necessary.
extracted_technique: Residual stacked fully-connected blocks for forecasting; can be used as a compact neural candidate trained on windowed sequences with careful leakage control.
takeaway: N-BEATS provides a strong, relatively simple neural alternative for forecasting; it’s a credible escalation path if engineered GBDTs underperform.
